description: This Java class 'OrderCriteria' extends 'Criteria' and provides fields and accessor methods to specify search or filter criteria for orders based on customer name, payment method, and customer ID.

classes.name: OrderCriteria
classes.description: A Java class used to define search criteria for orders, including customer name, payment method, and customer ID.

methods.name: setPaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets the payment method for the order criteria.

methods.name: getPaymentMethod
methods.description: Returns the payment method used in the order criteria.

methods.name: setCustomerName
methods.description: Sets the customer name for filtering orders.

methods.name: getCustomerName
methods.description: Retrieves the customer name used in filtering.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Gets the customer ID associated with the order criteria.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID for filtering orders.
